parts.tooltip: STM a — an atomic action on TVars (transactional variables). Not yet committed.
(a ⟶ STM b) — given result a of the first action, constructs the next atomic step

Sequences two STM actions within ONE transaction:
1. run sa to get a
2. pass a to f to get STM b
3. run that action
If any readTVar conflicts → the entire composed transaction retries from scratch.
STM b — the composed atomic action. Runs inside atomically :: STM a -> IO a.
